question: People who wear bifocal lenses have _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**presbyopia.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The gradual loss of your eyes' capacity to focus on** adjacent things **is known as presbyopia.
 
• It commonly appears in your **early to mid-40s** and worsens until you reach the **age of 65.**
 
• Presbyopia is caused by the** ciliary muscles weakening** and the eye lens becoming less flexible with age. As a result, the **eye's accommodation power** is lost, and the user is unable to view nearer objects well.
 
• **Glasses with bifocal power** and appropriate **focal lengths** are frequently used to remedy this problem. The **upper half** of the lens is** concave,** which corrects **myopia** and allows you to **see distant objects **clearly, while the** lower part** is** convex,** which corrects** hypermetropia** and allows you to see **nearer items** clearly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Hypermetropia**__** **

 __
 
• A person with **hypermetropia/hyperopia,** also known as **long sight,** can** see objects clearly from afar** but not up close.
 
• When the** eye is shorter than normal** or the** cornea is overly flat**, light rays **focus behind the retina**, causing hypermetropia (long-sightedness). The retina cannot concentrate light rays from close objects, such as book pages, clearly.
 
• It is **corrected **by spectacles or contact lenses with lenses that are** 'plus' or convex in shape.**
 
 
 
• **​Myopia__**
 __
 
• ​**Nearsightedness (myopia)** is a vision problem in which** items close** to you are **clearly seen** but objects further away are **blurry.**
 
• When light rays bend (refract) wrongly due to the structure of your eye,** focusing images in front of your retina** instead of on your retina.
 
• When one spends too much time in a **state of near focus**, myopia worsens. Activities like **reading **for extended periods of time or **knitting** might aggravate the issue.
 
• Myopia glasses commonly have a** concave (inwardly curved) lens**, which shifts the light's focus to help you see well. Myopia is corrected by **single vision lenses.**
 
 
 
• **​Cataract__**
 
 
• ​Cataract occurs when the normal lens of your eye becomes** hazy. Proteins** in your lens degrade, making objects appear **fuzzy, foggy, or less colourful.**
 
• The** most common** cause is** ageing.** This is due to the regular ageing of the eyes, which begins around the **age of 40.**
 
• **Other causes** of cataracts include someone having** cataracts in your family members**, having certain **medical problems** like diabetes, smoking, having had an **eye injury**,** eye surgery,** or** radiation treatments** on your upper body, having spent a lot of time in the** sun**, especially without sunglasses that protect your eyes from** damaging ultraviolet (UV) rays**, or using certain medications, such as** corticosteroids, **which may cause the early formation of cataracts.
 
• **Cataract surgery** is the only **effective treatment** for cataracts.
